description: The DG heuristic is an admissible lower bound for the high level of CBS that is at least as strong as the CG heuristic. Two agents are *dependent* when their MDDs (the layered sets of all their cheapest paths) contain no pair of paths without a conflict. The heuristic builds the *dependency graph*, with an edge for each dependent pair, and returns a lower bound on its minimum vertex cover. A cardinal conflict always makes a pair dependent, so DG has every edge of CG and more; the other pairs need a joint search over the two MDDs. `cbs` uses DG by default (`CbsHeuristic::Dg`), for the sum of costs only.

papers.authors: Jiaoyang Li, Ariel Felner, Eli Boyarski, Hang Ma, Sven Koenig
papers.title: Improved Heuristics for Multi-Agent Path Finding with Conflict-Based Search
papers.venue: International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI)

lineage.source: mapf-search, docs/design.md: "A cardinal conflict implies dependence ... The bound is the same vertex cover as CG's, over a superset of its edges."
